ns2:course.label: Cooperative Engr Seminar
ns2:course.description: Discussion seminar for on-campus cooperative education students. Topics include industrial work reports, online company card reports, on-line ABET reports, the Co-op/Internship Job Fair, the Co-op Information Night, the Co-op Society, and membership in the Co-op Honor Society. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Enrollment as a cooperative education student
